NEARWEEK EDITION #22
6 SEP - 12 SEP 2021

NEARWEEK is aggregating and curating information across the NEAR ecosystem. This edition was crowdsourced via 32 news contributions to the NEWS DAO.

Want to earn $NEAR and help spread the news of the ecosystem? Please read our step-by-step guide on how to submit news and make 1 $NEAR pr. contribution!

Big things around the ecosystem:

  • The AltRank™ for NEAR was 1 out of the top 2,909 coins last week.
  • NEAR is now available on CoinBene Global.
  • Paras 2.0 is now live! Paras migration correctly adopted the NFT token standard, and you can now see your collectibles inside NEAR wallet.
  • Aurora launches its validator on NEAR.
  • Milestone for Ref Finance: TVL from $4m to +$60m in few days.
  • $REF and $Skyward now listed on CoinGecko!

NEAR’s week by the numbers:

  • Total transactions: 28,679,165
  • Total accounts: 930,174
  • Weekly active accounts: 186,303
  • Monthly active developers: 883

Check out the full metrics dashboard here and last week’s metrics update here.

4 week transactions overview:

1280×720 197 KB

NEAR Wallet week 36 Update:

  • Ledger Nano is back on Chrome and Brave! Go to https://wallet.staging.near.org, test it and leave your feedback on support channels (In wallet UI or FAQ)
  • New account creation flow is coming! Wallet will ask for a mobile number or email to create “zero-funding” accounts. Test it at the same link as above and leave your feedback.

1280×720 208 KB

Results:

  • 780kNEAR accounts, + 20% since last week.

  • ~139,000 monthly active users, +12% since last week.
  • New coin-op and Ledger Nano libraries on staging.
  • Long-term vision of the new wallet is ready, going under internal review.

DAOs:

  • SputnikDAO metrics:

    • Total distributed all-time: 717,514 $NEAR
    • Total transactions: 13,257
    • Total DAOs: 206
    • TVL: 333,988 $NEAR

  • Sputnik / Astro update

  • The ‘Hot DAO Summer’ party of the Open Web Sandbox was HOT.

  • Creatives DAO weekly [APPROVED] proposals.

DeFi:

  • BSC bridge to NEAR about to hit mainnet soon?!
  • Read the post-mortem on the Ref Finance exploit here.
    • Check out the new Ref explained video.
  • The community board has approved the Cheddar Genesis!
  • NEAR in Binance 48-Hour thrilling flash promo.
  • HEO presents the second fundraising campaign.

Developers:

  • NEAR Core Engineering update available here.
    • Includes dev platform, wallet, node experience, node interface, core, contract runtime and DevRel reports.
  • Cryptographic Hash Functions with Evgeny Kapun.
  • Validators: A new version of nearcore 1.21.0 was released for mainnet.
    • nearcore 1.21.0 introduced a new protocol version, so once 2/3 of validators are upgraded, older nodes will get stuck. Thus, if you use Indexer Framework and run your own Indexer, it is time to upgrade. Please, follow this guide: [indexer] Get ready for nearcore 1.21.0 · near/nearcore · Discussion #4689 · GitHub
  • Validator AMA on Thursday, Sep. 23, 5pm GMT. Get your questions answered about the upcoming sharding change. Sign up now!
    • We’re steadily approaching the launch of Simple Nightshade which will lead to the launch of sharding on NEAR!

1280×720 198 KB

Project Growth:

  • With leading social + market activity, the AltRank™ for NEAR was 1 out of the top 2,909 coins last week.
  • NEAR Grants program weekly update.
  • Ecosystem Succes Team weekly update.
  • Deadline for MetaBUIDL Hackathon submissions postponed to Sept. 19.
  • Community Fund Processes: USD Pricing.
    • This forum post addresses the issue of Community Fund payouts denominated in NEAR tokens.
  • NEAR has awarded CurioInvest a developer grant expanding carbon neutral tokenization of collectible assets.
  • The Local Hack Node Event in Nigeria was successful. Read more here.
  • OWS Rewards and Opportunities September 2021.
  • The “Creators of the Blockchain” OWS program has officially launched.

1280×720 245 KB

Projects:

  • Aurora’s weekly update can be read here or watched here.
    • More than $50mio. total assets bridged!
  • e-Money explores integration with Aurora.
  • Illia Polosukhin hosted an AMA on Reddit, check out the thread!
  • Overview of top core projects on NEAR with own token.
  • Croncat is in the final stages of being an official legal entity, testnet entity, mainnet entity & fully decentralized DAO.
  • Sybil attack detected at http://LearnNEAR.Club!
  • Unique One appchain joined Octopus Network.
    • Wanna learn more about “The Octopus Network Reach”?
  • This week on Next Creators Podcast: What is Liquid Staking? w/ Meta Pool Co-founders Lucio Tato & Claudio Cossio.
  • Mintbase got a new community manager, please give a warm welcome!

Gaming:

  • Join the NEAR Games community on Telegram.
  • Bloomberg Tech & Ideas: How Gaming Will Change Humanity as We Know It.
  • Roughly 20 games so far are being built on NEAR, likely it will get to 100 games within 12 months.
  • Metamon Reveal Day is set for Sept 17 at 5pm (EST).
    • Revealing: the revamped Metamon world, 3 of first Gen 1 characters, Metamon lore and story, and limited edition character collectibles!
  • How to build a Play To Earn game: A guide that will enable you to create a play to earn game on NEAR.
  • Voice chat is live now on main domain for http://near-lands.onrender.com
  • Shroom Kingdom is looking for graphic designers who will help with the designs for the upcoming NFT airdrop.

Events

  • Join the NEAR Protocol RU-Community contest and get a chance to win a NFT + $50 in $REF.
  • Q&A ~ Open Web Contributors. Every week on Wednesday GMT+1
  • It’s time for MetaBUIDL Hackathon with NEAR. The infrastructure is ready to onboard the next billion users to Web3 - $1MIO in prizes!. Aug. 27 - Sep. 19.
  • The State of the NEAR Ecosystem hosted by 4NTS Guild, Sept. 16, 9:30 PST.
  • Validator AMA on Thursday, Sep. 23, 5pm GMT. Get your questions answered about the upcoming sharding change. Sign up now!
  • Another NEARZone Call of Duty Warzone event is coming up, Sep 26, 8PM GMT+2!

Guilds:

  • Explore the NEARverse with NEARWEEK & AwesomeNEAR part 2.
    • The winners of the first #ExploreTheNEARverse.
  • NEAR Legal Guild: Business Ops Lessons for Crypto Project Founders.
  • Open Forest Protocol headed to SWISS FINTECH Fair.
    • How OFP works.
  • The Corpsemen Guild: A Community for the New Carbon Future. Get enrolled and start making a difference!
  • Degens: Weekly News №6 is out.
  • September week 1 recap by Merchants of NEAR
  • Take a glance at NxM ecosystem map.

Infrastructure:

  • You can now share stats about any NEAR account using a link to https://stats.gallery.
  • What Is The Future Of Interoperability? Octopus founder Louis Liu recently participated in a panel with NEAR and the Cosmos ecosystem
    • OCT Token Timelock Contract Bug Bounty Program.
  • Check out the Analytics wiki page that aggregates data tools in the ecosystem.
  • A rant about developer adoption and why @marwolwarl “likes” NEAR”.
    • The NEAR Protocol thread for those too lazy to read.
  • Want to know more about NEAR’s sharding system? Read it here.
  • As the NEAR network matures, a new role is emerging: Chunk-Only Producers.
  • $26,500 lost on failed ETH transaction. Reason: not enough gas. Not gonna happen using NEAR!

NFTs:

  • New features added to Mintbase: Remove minters from your store and Storage Full Meter.
  • How to mint NFTs on Paras.
  • NEAR Nft Club introduces - NEAR NFT WEEKLY NEWS.
  • Almost $6k USD was the price on Sep 11 to mint one NFT on $ETH.

Open jobs in the NEARverse

  • Current job openings at NEAR.
  • Project managing the Treasury governance project.
  • FLUX is looking for RUST and Solidity engineers and a Technical Product Manager.
  • Ref Finance is Hiring! 5 positions are up for grabs: Product Manager, UI Designer, Front-End Engineer, Back-End Engineer and QA Engineer.
  • Paras Digital is looking for game developers.
  • Aurora is looking for a QA Engineer.
  • Cron Cat is looking for a designer and commanders!
  • Flying Rhino (NEAR SoMe Guild) is looking for people!
  • Reddit Manager wanted for r/Mintbase and r/NEARNFT’s.
  • Open Forest Protocol is hiring.

Other updates:

  • NEAR community metrics update here.
  • NEAR’s Community Squad weekly update.
  • NEAR Mates’ weekly recap.
